set.name: M0 pilot — 100 items, EN+FA
set.authoring: Gold refs chosen from canonical, widely-known verses independently of the retriever. Not used to tune retrieval; retrieval was not consulted while authoring.
limits: expect_refs is not exhaustive: a miss is a lower bound on recall, not proof of failure.
No independent scholar has reviewed these items. Step 6 of M0 requires one.
Sensitive verses (4:34, 9:5 and similar) are deliberately absent: they need the sensitivity path from M1, not the plain answer path.
Categories are not equal-sized; proportions are reported per category with intervals.
